body_html:
How to think about it

Most water in nature is a solution: sea water contains dissolved salts, and rivers carry dissolved minerals, oxygen and sometimes pollutants. Concentration can be expressed as percent by mass, grams per liter or moles per liter.

The pH of water and soil affects living things: acid rain and mine waste lower the pH of rivers. Water quality is tested by pH, dissolved oxygen, turbidity and bacteria. Water is treated by filtration, settling and chlorination before we drink it.

Example

10 g of salt in 200 g of solution. Percent by mass?

10 ÷ 200 × 100

Answer: 5%

Example

Which gas causes acid rain?

From burning fossil fuels

Answer: sulfur dioxide (and nitrogen oxides)

Common mistakes

  • Thinking clear water is always safe.
  • Thinking a pH of 6 is more basic than 8.
  • Mixing up solute and solvent.

faq.q: Why does warm water hold less dissolved oxygen?
faq.a: Gases are less soluble in warmer water, so fish may suffocate in hot weather.

faq.q: How is drinking water made safe?
faq.a: By filtering, settling and adding chlorine to kill microorganisms.

items.q: Which kind of pollution is caused by oil spilled from a ship?

items.q: Why is ocean water salty?
c: Rivers carry dissolved minerals from weathered rock into the sea, where water evaporates and leaves salt behind.

items.q: Mae's class studies this problem: “Forests are cleared for new houses.” Which solution would best reduce the impact?
c: public transit, electric vehicles and cleaner power
planting grass buffer strips along the river and using less fertilizer
rain gardens and permeable sidewalk that soak up runoff
keeping protected green spaces and wildlife corridors
items.e: A good solution targets the cause of the impact.

items.q: What is permeability?
c: how easily water can flow through a material

items.q: What is a rain garden?

a garden that only grows in rain
items.e: Rain gardens reduce flooding and pollution.

items.q: What is a low-flow showerhead?
c: a showerhead that uses less water per minute
items.e: It saves water and the energy to heat it.

items.q: What does pH measure in water?
c: how acidic or basic the water is
items.e: Most aquatic life needs a pH near 7.

items.q: What is one way to reduce farm runoff?

items.q: Which kind of pollution is caused by construction work all night?
